editorial_policy: Authorities are used for chronology, geometry, place identity, and evidence. Wikipedia and LLM summaries may support readable context only and may not author dates, boundaries, geometry, or confidence claims.

tiers.A: Formal standards, primary scientific model documentation, peer-reviewed or institutionally maintained datasets used as authority.
tiers.B: Curated academic gazetteers, museum/university collections, or scholarly synthesis used for context and place linkage.
tiers.C: Community/open datasets useful when provenance is inspectable and claims remain bounded.
tiers.D: Discovery and readable context only; never authoritative for atlas claims.

sources.name: International Commission on Stratigraphy
sources.use: Formal chronostratigraphic interval names and boundary ages.
sources.license_status: Published chart; verify current chart version before major release.

sources.name: GPlates CAO2024 reconstruction model
sources.use: Pinned plate-reconstruction geometry from present to 1.8 Ga where supported.
sources.license_status: Model documentation and dataset terms must remain pinned by version.

sources.name: PaleoDEM / PALEOMAP elevation and bathymetry resources
sources.use: Candidate source for Phanerozoic elevation and bathymetry anchor worlds.
sources.license_status: Redistribution and derived-tile permissions require review before public shipping.

sources.name: Paleoclimate Modelling Intercomparison Project
sources.use: Model ensembles and benchmarks for selected paleoclimate intervals.
sources.license_status: Model outputs vary by project and repository; verify per dataset.

sources.name: Paleobiology Database
sources.use: Fossil occurrence evidence used as discovery locations, not complete organism ranges.
sources.license_status: Open data; cite PBDB and contributing collections.

sources.name: Smithsonian Human Origins Program
sources.use: Human evolution, dispersal, fossil, behavioral, and environmental context.
sources.license_status: Institutional educational source; quote and reuse restrictions must be respected.

sources.name: PeriodO
sources.use: Scholarly period definitions and authority-scoped labels.
sources.license_status: Open data; verify current API/data terms.

sources.name: Pleiades
sources.use: Ancient place names, locations, attestations, and linked references.
sources.license_status: CC BY 3.0 for published data; attribution required.

sources.name: World Historical Gazetteer
sources.use: Linked historical place records and name reconciliation.
sources.license_status: Dataset terms vary by contributed source.

sources.name: OpenHistoricalMap
sources.use: Dated map features when tags, dates, and provenance are visible.
sources.license_status: ODbL-style terms; attribution and share-alike obligations require review for derived products.

sources.name: Wikipedia
sources.license_status: CC BY-SA content; avoid copying long text.
